comment: P4-02 wasm/native compile cells. Every wasm cfg site's crate must be covered by a wasm cell (direct package or its dependency closure); every not-wasm site's crate by the native cell. gpu-web-probe is an independent wasm probe and MUST stay in wasm-default (it is not in game_web's closure). Design-native crates go in exclusions with owner/review_by.
